prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Charles MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Jeremy Schneider of SCHNEIDER Real Estate
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home type, and price range. Based on the available local results, **Jeremy Schneider of SCHNEIDER Real Estate** looks like a strong candidate to interview: his profile shows substantial seller-side activity in the area and many positive client reviews. **Sandra Meranda** is another candidate, with a large recorded sales history and seller reviews mentioning pricing and negotiation.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents and ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side sales near your home**, especially similar homes
- Their pricing recommendation and the comparable sales behind it
- A specific marketing and showing plan
- Their listing fee, contract terms, and communication schedule

Compare their plans and local results—not just online ratings. Sources: [Jeremy Schneider](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/jeremy-schneider/lg1yyqe/), [Sandra Meranda](https://www.zillow.com/profile/sandrameranda), [St. Charles agent directory](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/saint-charles-mo/).
